liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star//** (2 reviews): The performance did not gain significant energy until the second half of the song; Jerry seemed frustrated, preventing the band from finding their mojo during this performance [4][8]
- **//New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): The song features unusual backing vocals, following a cut from the end of Dark Star [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-12-26.sbd.warner-evans.28448.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 124 min; rated 4.2/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: The Dark Star splices to New Speedway Boogie, likely missing about four minutes of material [1]
- **gd69-12-26.sbd.murphy.1821.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 122 min; rated 4.24/5 by 25 [2]. Said about its sound: Acoustic guitars are clear, though the recording feels solid but short overall; The recording cuts out during Cold Rain And Snow and chops China Cat; The sound quality is described as nice for this historical recording [4][6][7][14]
- **gd1969-12-26.136636.electric.sbd.mr.cass.sirmick.flac1648**: soundboard; 10 songs; 79 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Bobby and Jerry played acoustic standards while waiting for Billy, who arrived late [4]
- Bill arrived late due to Christmas, prompting an unexpected acoustic first set [5]
- The band waited for Bill to arrive, performing gospel and country standards [6]
- Billy was late, leading to what the reviewer calls the first official acoustic performance [7]
- A fourteen-year-old attended their first concert here, finding the event life-changing [12]
- The show was a stopover on the way to the East Coast from California [14]
- The first set was fantastic, while the energy for the rest was only okay [5]
- This show and the Fillmore show both claim to be the first acoustic set [9]
- This show is better than the December 19th set because it is longer [11]
- An April 1969 Avalon show also opened in acoustic mode, featuring Jerry on vocals [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-12-26.sbd.warner-evans.28448.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Jack Warner, Marc Evans, Jim Powell; source: MSR> CASS> DAT> CDR> EAC> FLAC [1]. Also: Defects in Cold Rain and China Cat were corrected using a second-generation cassette source [1]
- **gd69-12-26.sbd.murphy.1821.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bob Murphy; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Cuts exist at China Cat, Dark Star, and New Speedway Boogie on all circulating versions [2]
- **gd1969-12-26.136636.electric.sbd.mr.cass.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Set 2 Source: sbd > Master Reel > Cassette > Dat (48k) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead SMU McFarlin Auditorium 1969 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-at-smu-mcfarlin-auditorium-1969) [17]
